text: Hey folks, quick question about the 'General & Entity Specific Benefits & Information > Travel, Community & Support' section—does anyone know what kind of support we get if something happens during business travel? Like, medical emergencies or lost baggage?

Yep! So for business travel, we’re covered by International SOS—basically, 24/7 medical, safety, and security assistance. There’s also travel insurance that covers emergency medical stuff, accidents, and baggage issues, both domestic and international. You just need to download the ISOS app with your GitLab email, and if you need help, hit the 'Need Assistance' button. There’s also a membership card with emergency numbers if you prefer calling. It’s all automatic, so you don’t have to sign up or anything.
